moments.author: Variety
moments.quote: Rob Reiner has won a posthumous Emmy for outstanding guest actor in a comedy series in “The Bear.” This win marks the first posthumous Emmy for an on‑camera performance since Raúl Julia won for “The Burning Season” in 1995.
moments.why: This sparked conversation because it marked a rare posthumous Emmy recognition for an on‑screen performance, drawing attention both to Reiner’s legacy and the unusual timing of the honor.

moments.author: Variety
moments.quote: Linda Cardellini has won her first Emmy, taking home the award for supporting actress in a limited or anthology series for her role in “DTF St. Louis.” Cardellini was previously nominated for her roles in “Mad Men” and “Dead to Me.”
moments.why: It went viral because longtime fans celebrated Cardellini’s first Emmy win after years of acclaimed performances and nominations.

moments.author: Barbara Eden
moments.quote: It’s okay everyone! I’m okay! Oh, my goodness there has been a bit of miscommunication. I’m not suffering from an illness; my doctor very recently prescribed a brand‑new medication that turned out to have some nasty side effects. …
moments.why: Her warm, personal reassurance following a last‑minute cancellation at age 95 reassured and deeply moved fans across social media.
